# Company
> Banaraswala Wire Mesh Private Limited (BWM) is an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer of industrial wire mesh and metal filtration products since 1986, headquartered in India with branches in Hyderabad, Mumbai and Coimbatore.

## About
BWM manufactures and supplies woven wire mesh, perforated sheets, vibrating screen wire mesh, welded mesh, expanded metal and chainlink fencing. Serving 10,000+ B2B customers across India including mining, construction, agriculture, automotive, pharmaceuticals, food & beverage and filtration industries.

## Products
- Wire Mesh: SS 304/316, brass, copper, aluminum, GI. Mesh counts 2–500, apertures from 25 microns.
- Perforated Sheet: stainless steel, aluminum, brass, mild steel. Custom hole sizes and patterns.
- Vibrating Screen Wire Mesh: high-carbon spring steel, for mining and quarrying.
- Welded Mesh: galvanized, stainless steel, PVC-coated. For fencing, cages, reinforcement.
- Expanded Metal: mild steel, stainless steel, aluminum. For walkways, screens, security.
- Chainlink Fencing: galvanized and PVC-coated. For boundary fencing and sports enclosures.
